correctness.rationale: The exact 21-facet complex is reconstructed, its face vector is verified, and the standard recursive shellability criterion is evaluated for every nonempty tetrahedron subset. All unordered complementary partitions are exhaustively checked; retained intersections are independently reconstructed, tested for pure dimension two, and tested for shellability. The finalized standalone verifier reproduces the 247 total, the complete size distribution, and exactly three size-five witnesses. No sampling, floating point, timeout, or inference from logs is used.

value.rationale: The exact object is a classical strongly non-shellable yet constructible 3-ball, so the first decomposition layer is mathematically motivated rather than an arbitrary slice. The sharp five-tetrahedron lower bound and the complete three-witness classification quantify how shellable pieces can assemble a globally nonshellable ball, while the full distribution supplies a reproducible benchmark for constructibility-search algorithms.
